SWS DIAGNOSIS

SIMPLIFIED WIRING SYSTEM (SWS)
54B-13
DIAGNOSTIC TROUBLE CODE PROCEDURES
DTC 11: ETACS-ECU fault
DTC SET CONDITION
DTC 11 is displayed when the ETACS-ECU detects 
an error is its own data. This fault is limited to the 
ETACS-ECU.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINT
Malfunction of the ETACS-ECU
DIAGNOSIS
Required Special Tool:
• MB991502: Scan Tool (MUT-II)
Replace the ETACS-ECU.
Confirm that DTC 11 is not displayed.
